sources.label: home page HTML (inline <style data-theme=...> token blocks)

dark.toggle: html[data-color-mode=dark][data-theme~="dark:dark"] (set by JS from prefers-color-scheme or the 'Set website theme' button)

notes: Gatsby site. The home page HTML inlines the @atlaskit/tokens theme CSS as <style data-theme=light|dark|spacing|shape|typography|motion>. Diff against @atlaskit/tokens 20.9.0: light 466/466, dark 466/466, spacing 38/38, shape 11/11 declarations identical.

html carries data-color-mode=light in the static HTML; a head script switches it to dark when prefers-color-scheme: dark (verified: with emulated dark, data-color-mode=dark and body bg #1f1f21). There is also a 'Set website theme' button. So both attribute and media preference drive dark mode.
Tokens with alpha are 8-digit hex (ds-border #0b120e24, ds-background-neutral #0515240f).
Many decorative backgrounds on the home page are accent tokens (lime/orange/red/purple, e.g. #94c748, #fca700, #f87168, #eed7fc) used in illustrations/cards; not listed as roles.
Radius: home page also computes 9999px (= --ds-radius-full 624.9375rem, pills) and 25% (= --ds-radius-tile); 24/27/28px radii are not tokens. Spacing 1px is not a token.

Font sizes 48px and 88px (Charlie Display hero headings) are not defined by the typography tokens and are excluded; typography source is the inline data-theme=typography block (the font-family tokens; sizes 0.75-2rem).
Values measured at default Playwright viewport.
